reviews_1s:
Click to play video
I got this 6-pack funnel set thinking it would cover all my kitchen needs, but I ended up very disappointed. The black silicone funnels are the only decent part—collapsible, easy to store, and no rough edges. The white plastic funnels feel thin and cheaply made, with sharp seam lines and plastic flash (the thin leftover plastic from the molding process), I’d never trust around food. Even removing the strange T-shaped plastic shipping hook was a chore. I’d maybe use the plastic ones in a garage or auto shop, but certainly not in my kitchen. Overall, I can’t recommend this set.

Pros:
• Black silicone funnels are collapsible and easy to store
• Includes a variety of sizes

Cons:
• White plastic funnels have rough edges and feel flimsy
• Awkward T-shaped hook for packaging
• Poorly made
• Not suitable for food prep in my opinion —only the black silicone ones seem safe
